# ghost/freecell

Open Patience (F-Droid) FreeCell: deal a game (classic, 2 or 6 cells), tap cards to move them, undo/redo and read the full board (cells, foundations, columns, moves, time). Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/freecell
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/freecell new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/freecell tap_card --device <serial> --param card=<card>
ghost skill run ghost/freecell tap_column --device <serial> --param column=<column>
ghost skill run ghost/freecell undo_move --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/freecell get_board --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Deal a new FreeCell game
- `tap_card`: Move the seven of hearts in FreeCell
- `tap_column`: Play the bottom card of the third FreeCell column
- `undo_move`: Undo my last FreeCell move
- `get_board`: What does my FreeCell board look like?
